verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly show declarative retry with configurable exponential backoff (10 retries) and dedicated errors-retrying documentation, plus queue concurrency, timeouts, and failure-state handling (delayed/queued/executing/failed) built into the task runtime — all without manual try/catch. Community feedback corroborates reliability in practice (e.g., replacing brittle Puppeteer jobs, praise for retry.onThrow default). missing for 10: no dedicated doc excerpt on per-step custom failure policies beyond backoff/retry count, and no independent benchmark of timeout configurability.
